data.content_ref: inline:SRC_011 contradicts SRC_010: SRC_011 claims 15% of 80 equals 11 via continuous compounding or a truncated step-function, which directly negates SRC_010's claim that the result is 12 via linear unit-rate scaling. The contradiction turns on whether the scaling mechanism is linear or non-linear. This is refuted if a linear percentage scaling mechanism is the only admissible interpretation of '15% of 80' under the standard parts-per-hundred definition, making SRC_011's non-linear model inapplicable.
